behaviour: The page you designed opens as itself at /site/<slug>
when: tap ↗ (View page) in the builder header, or open /site/<slug> signed in
expect: the live variant renders at the device's real width with no editing chrome; pending edits are saved first so the served page always equals the board
howToTest: 1. arrange the board (add a block, don't press Save)  2. tap ↗  3. the served page shows the arrangement you just made; back in the builder the button reads Saved

behaviour: Hiding one pane hides only that pane, even when two panes show the same block
when: two panes of one block are on the page; hide one of them at a width
expect: only that pane leaves the layout (its own id is in the breakpoint's hidden list); the other stays; the choice survives save and reload
howToTest: 1. tap the Form chip twice → two Form panes  2. tap the second, Hide at this width → one Form pane left, eye-off count 1  3. Save, reload → still one
consideredRejected: hidden list keyed by block id only → ❌ hid every pane of that block

behaviour: A served page lays out the same on Safari as on Chrome

expect: every pane gets its content height; nothing collapses to zero (the page render never uses the builder's fill-the-frame layouts)
howToTest: 1. page = form + nav bar stacked, stats below  2. open /site/<slug> on an iPhone  3. form at the top, nav strip under it, stats below; ?debug=1 lists the form pane at its content height, not 0
